findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ai_capabilities, compare_pos · Private data: ai_capabilities, contact_and_demo · Public sink: integrations, contact_and_demo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ai_capabilities, compare_pos · Private data: ai_capabilities, contact_and_demo · Public sink: integrations, contact_and_demo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
